item.title: Towada Art Center: Open-Air Contemporary Art — Guide
item.description: The Towada Art Center scatters world-class contemporary art across central Towada City. Its free outdoor sculpture park — with works by Ron Mueck, Yayoi Kusama and others — turns an ordinary street into an open-air gallery, while the compact indoor galleries hold striking permanent commissions. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Towada City, Aomori Hours ~9:00–17:00 (closed Mon) Admission Outdoor free; indoor ~¥1,800 Time needed 1–1.
